name: Allow + empty NotResource complement (masked broad-resource)
note: IAM-1508 / S2-guard-parity regression. An Allow whose only resource element is a present-but-empty NotResource ([]) excludes NOTHING, so it applies to EVERY resource - the byte-equivalent of Resource:"*". The engine reads it as no resource scope and never fires WILDCARD-RESOURCE; the shared engine must mark coverage INCOMPLETE (EMPTY_NOTRESOURCE_COMPLEMENT) so neither surface reports a clean pass while the identical Resource:"*" policy blocks.
